facts.text: Westmont means 'west mountain' in English, a descriptive name likely derived from its geographical location relative to a prominent mountain or mountainous terrain in the vicinity.
Westmont was originally part of Rancho Sausal Redondo, a 22,458‑acre Mexican land grant awarded on May 20, 1837, to Antonio Ygnacio Avila by Governor Juan Bautista Alvarado.
The Southern Pacific line reached the South Bay by 1869, and the Los Angeles & Redondo Railway opened in 1890, linking Los Angeles with Redondo Beach.
Westmont enjoys a Mediterranean climate (Köppen Csb), with mild winters, occasional rain, and hot, dry summers shaped by coastal proximity and the urban heat island effect.
Ice Cube, the rapper and actor, grew up on Van Wick Street in Westmont.
